headline: Punjab Government Teacher Resigns After Realizing He Was Just A Life-Sized Cardboard Cutout Propped Up By Department
body:
Harpreet Singh, a supposed secondary school educator from Hoshiarpur, officially resigned from his post on Tuesday after discovering that his primary job function for the last three years has been standing perfectly still near the staff room to boost the school’s 'visual occupancy' metrics during surprise district inspections.

“I honestly thought the lack of students and the fact that nobody ever gave me a chalkboard marker was just a severe administrative oversight,” said Singh, who spent 1,095 consecutive days wearing a blazer in 40-degree heat. “It wasn’t until a janitor tried to dust my forehead and accidentally tilted me over that I realized I wasn’t actually receiving a salary, but rather a monthly stipend for ‘static display maintenance.’”

The state education department has defended the move, insisting that the presence of high-quality, weather-resistant staff silhouettes is a revolutionary cost-cutting measure. A departmental spokesperson noted that while the cutouts cannot grade papers or teach algebra, they possess a perfect attendance record and never once complained about the lack of laboratory equipment, unlike the previous human teachers who were let go for ‘excessive questioning.’

Singh, currently seeking employment at an actual school, noted that his time as a stationary exhibit has provided him with unparalleled patience. He remains hopeful that his next employer will provide him with a desk, a curriculum, and perhaps the ability to move his legs without the help of a custodial crew.
caption: When your teaching method is just 'don't move and stay in the frame.' Hard to argue with those numbers. #EducationReform #PunjabSchools #TeacherLife #Satire (satire)
igHook: Would you ever realize you were just a prop in your own office? Tag a coworker who is definitely a cardboard cutout.
imagePrompt: A wide-angle, slightly blurry candid shot of a school staff room hallway with a generic, professional-looking teacher standing in the background against a wall, captured from the perspective of someone walking past.

sourceHeadline.title: AAP Expels Punjab MLA For Alleging Lack Of Teachers In Government Schools

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 10 wins by taking the 'infrastructure neglect' theme and elevating it with the specific, absurdist image of a human being treated as a piece of office furniture for three years. It avoids the repetitive WhatsApp-expulsion formula used by many other candidates and provides a unique, vivid satirical take on administrative performativity.

safetyVerdict.reasoning: The article uses a fictional, generic protagonist named 'Harpreet Singh' to satirize administrative bureaucracy in education; the name is extremely common in Punjab and does not refer to a specific private or public individual. The image prompt and content are harmless, satirical, and do not violate any safety guidelines.
